rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone or something does not have or is short of something.

example.english: I lack the time to do this report.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan3 zou6 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a deficiency or shortfall, especially in formal or general descriptions.

example.english: The biggest problem with this plan is a lack of funding.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃最大嘅問題係資金不足。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 man6 tai4 hai6 zi1 gam1 bat1 zuk1

rows.note: Use this for a shortage or dearth of supplies, resources, workers, or other available quantities.

example.english: There is a lack of face masks on the market.
example.jyutping: si5 min6 soeng6 hau2 zaau3 dyun2 kyut3

rows.note: Use this mainly for an abstract quality, resource, or condition that is lacking, especially in formal or written language rather than everyday speech.

example.english: This report points out that elderly people in Hong Kong lack sufficient digital support.
example.traditional: 呢份報告指出，本港長者缺乏足夠嘅數碼支援。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 bun2 gong2 coeng4 ze2 kyut3 fat6 zuk1 gau3 ge3 sou3 maa5 zi1 wun4
